tactics:
induction j with
| zero => intro l; rfl
| succ j ih => intro l; cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l => simp [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc, ih]
induction j <;> intro l <;> cases l <;> simp_all [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc]

induction j with
| zero => intro l; rfl
| succ j ih => intro l; cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l => show a :: _ = a :: _; rw [ih]
induction j <;> intro l <;> cases l <;> simp [List.modifyTailIdx, Nat.add_succ, *]
